integrity: Exact regenerative conditional-Gaussian calculation and complete parameter sign proof; symbolic, quadrature and seeded Monte Carlo reproduction provided. Originality remains subject to unknown general-renewal implicit-coverage risk.
scientific_limitations: Free one-dimensional overdamped position with Gaussian OU active force; independent thermal Brownian noise; Poisson resets both position and force to zero. No results for partial resets, inertia, viscoelasticity, traps, passage times or distributional tail asymptotics.
title: A unique thermal-noise-induced kurtosis optimum under complete resetting of an active Ornstein–Uhlenbeck particle
